authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 125 aṅgāra explicitly lists Gawri, Kalasha, Khowar aṅgār, Bshk äṅgār, Maiya agār and Palula aṅgōr in the fire/charcoal family. These survey velar-nasal and vowel variants match the explicitly attested northern fire word. Previously reviewed comparator: Kho āngār “fire” (f_54frcx4eam32u). Exact survey transcription remains unchanged.
